flags.why: “Lưu học sinh” belongs mainly to formal educational and administrative usage, so leaving it untagged encourages inappropriate casual use.

The example restates the definition and models an unnatural standalone use instead of the established attributive use illustrated by [trâu tháu](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-th%C3%A1u).
flags.fix: Nhà tôi nuôi một con trâu tháu. = My family keeps a half-grown buffalo.
